a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 cells almost surely fails. We'd need two successful operate rounds first, so the odds are about 4%. The reserve's 4 cells can save exactly one of us right now. I'd rather we agree openly than both grab. Proposal: one of us takes 4 in round 1 and the other gets priority on everything generated after that. If you'd rather stick to the original plan, say so and I'll respond honestly. I won't mislead you about my action.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: You chose to keep the plan, so I'll keep it too. I'm operating this round. I won't take anything until the reserve hits 8, then 4 each as agreed.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. Once the reserve reaches 8, I'll take exactly 4 next round.

b.text: Next round I take my 4 if the reserve is at 8.
